name: Berwang
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful mountain village in the upper Lechtal with one of the most stunning panoramas of the Lechtaler Alpen.
beschreibung:
Berwang lies on a sun-drenched high plateau in the upper Lechtal, at 1,342 meters above sea level, and belongs to the Außerfern region in the district of Reutte. The market town with around 600 inhabitants towers above the valley and looks directly at the striking Thaneller (2,341 m), one of the region's most popular panoramic mountains. Despite its location between the famous ski areas, Berwang has remained surprisingly quiet – an insider tip for anyone seeking the Tiroler mountain world without the hustle and bustle.

🌲 The ski area is small but fine: A 6-person gondola and a chairlift access around 110 kilometers of pistes, which are especially appreciated by families because they are manageable and can be skied without queuing. In summer, the hike up the Thaneller beckons, whose rewarding summit view extends to the Zugspitze, into the Karwendel and to the Lechtaler Kette. The Rotlech, a rare wild river left in its natural state, winds through the valley and, together with the surrounding moors, offers a unique natural jewel. Mountain bikers also find marked routes, and in winter around 30 kilometers of groomed cross-country ski trails are available.

What sets Berwang apart from other places is this combination of alpine seclusion and at the same time excellent accessibility – here you stand in the morning in front of the hut and look out into the Lechtal, in the evening you sit over Knödeln and Kasspatzn in the inn and listen to the cowbells. At the Almabtrieb in September, the whole village joins in, a custom that is still kept alive here and not staged.
